proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B C D E F h1 h2 h3 w1 w2 w3
  have e1 := h3.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem h2 (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ C A)
  have e2 := h3.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem h1 (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B) (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B C)
  have e3 := h1.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem h2 (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B C) (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ C A)
  have d1 := w1.dist_add_dist
  have d2 := w2.dist_add_dist
  have d3 := w3.dist_add_dist
  rw [dist_comm D C] at d1
  rw [dist_comm E A] at d2
  rw [dist_comm F B] at d3
  rw [dist_comm C A] at d2
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D E F : P), s.IsTangentAt D line[ℝ, B, C] → s.IsTangentAt E line[ℝ, C, A] → s.IsTangentAt F line[ℝ, A, B] → Wbtw ℝ B D C → Wbtw ℝ C E A → Wbtw ℝ A F B → 2 * dist A F = dist A B + dist A C - dist B C
